digest.component_or_area: DC harness - Epic field readiness gate
propositions: Epic Link and Epic Name fields are provisioned by GreenHopper when the first Jira Software project is created, not at plugin startup
The session-start readiness gate in wait_for_jira_dc_ready waits for Epic fields before any project exists, creating a deadlock where the gate blocks the action that could provision the fields

A 180-second quiet wait produced no change in field inventory (27 fields, 0 customfield_*), but creating a project immediately registered 28 additional fields (55 total, 13 customfield_*) within 0.05 seconds, proving the defect is ordering not timing
The harness errored all 62 cells at fixture setup with byte-identical field inventories across 600s and 1800s budget attempts, with container idle ~29 minutes after plugin upgrades completed

The fix relocates the Epic field capability check from session start to immediately after project provisioning in _assert_project_capabilities, and reduces the budget from 600s to 120s based on measured 0.0512s provisioning time

The decision rule in not_ready_message ('empty customfield inventory means plugin still starting') is self-confirming and wrong, as an empty inventory is the normal state of a Jira instance with no project
